problem_text:
A logistics firm must coordinate a circuit for a specialized courier to deliver sensitive documents to ten distinct corporate offices, each situated at specific geographic points.  
Office Alpha is positioned at (95,107).  
Office Beta is positioned at (169,11).  
Office Gamma is positioned at (33,153).  
Office Delta is positioned at (5,100).  
Office Epsilon is positioned at (19,179).  
Office Zeta is positioned at (18,33).  
Office Eta is positioned at (107,76).  
Office Theta is positioned at (140,106).  
Office Iota is positioned at (189,36).  
Office Kappa is positioned at (151,108).  

Travel distances between offices, measured in kilometers, are predetermined:  
Alpha to Gamma: 77.2 km  
Alpha to Delta: 90.3 km  
Alpha to Epsilon: 104.7 km  
Alpha to Zeta: 106.8 km  
Alpha to Eta: 33.2 km  
Alpha to Theta: 45.0 km  
Alpha to Iota: 117.8 km  
Alpha to Kappa: 56.0 km  
Beta to Gamma: 196.6 km

Beta to Epsilon: 225.2 km

Beta to Theta: 99.3 km

Beta to Kappa: 98.7 km  
Gamma to Delta: 59.9 km  
Gamma to Epsilon: 29.5 km  
Gamma to Zeta: 120.9 km  
Gamma to Eta: 106.8 km  
Gamma to Theta: 116.9 km  
Gamma to Iota: 195.0 km  
Gamma to Kappa: 126.3 km  
Delta to Epsilon: 80.2 km  
Delta to Zeta: 68.2 km  
Delta to Eta: 104.8 km  
Delta to Theta: 135.1 km  
Delta to Iota: 194.8 km

Epsilon to Zeta: 146.0 km  
Epsilon to Eta: 135.5 km

Zeta to Eta: 98.8 km  
Zeta to Theta: 142.2 km  
Zeta to Iota: 171.0 km  
Zeta to Kappa: 152.7 km  
Eta to Theta: 44.6 km  
Eta to Iota: 91.2 km  
Eta to Kappa: 54.4 km  
Theta to Iota: 85.4 km  
Theta to Kappa: 11.2 km  
Iota to Kappa: 81.4 km  

Due to regulatory restrictions, a direct route between Office Alpha and Office Beta is prohibited.  
Furthermore, owing to a contractual obligation, the tour must incorporate exactly one of two specified critical links: either the connection between Office Beta and Office Gamma, or the connection between Office Gamma and Office Delta.  

The objective is to determine the most concise feasible circuit that visits every office precisely once and concludes at the origin point.
